      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "standardized_level",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a scale-aligned continuous input so a linear SVM can assign a stable margin weight without raw-unit dominance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",

    {
      "name": "overall_centered_level",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average standardized level across all five numeric columns, clipped for robustness.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures broad elevation or depression as a smooth near-linear projection for margin placement.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(((x001 - 0.823262) / 0.853562306272561 + (x002 - 1.248752) / 0.8268675104448919 + (x003 - 0.7785720000000002) / 0.9281793688808214 + (x004 - 0.3951213333333333) / 0.7988536953732864 + (x005 - 0.10097800000000001) / 0.5872891975134567) / 5.0, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "first_three_vs_last_two_z_contrast",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Contrasts the average standardized level of x001-x003 against x004-x005.",
      "value_range": [-6.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_contrast",

    },
    {
      "name": "x001_x002_signed_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Bounded signed ratio comparing x001 with x002, damped by their absolute magnitudes.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "bounded_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a stable pairwise imbalance cue while limiting leverage from extreme raw values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(x001 - x002) / (np.abs(x001) + np.abs(x002) + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "x003_x004_signed_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Bounded signed ratio comparing x003 with x004, damped by their absolute magnitudes.",

      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a stable pairwise imbalance cue while limiting leverage from extreme raw values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(x003 - x004) / (np.abs(x003) + np.abs(x004) + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "radial_standardized_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean norm of the five standardized deviations from the training-fold center, clipped for stability.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "continuous_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes overall distance from the central profile as one smooth severity measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.sqrt(((x001 - 0.823262) / 0.853562306272561) ** 2 + ((x002 - 1.248752) / 0.8268675104448919) ** 2 + ((x003 - 0.7785720000000002) / 0.9281793688808214) ** 2 + ((x004 - 0.3951213333333333) / 0.7988536953732864) ** 2 + ((x005 - 0.10097800000000001) / 0.5872891975134567) ** 2), 0.0, 8.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "coherent_direction_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assessor score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how consistently the five measurements sit on the same side of their training-fold means; high values indicate a coherent one-direction profile.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_profile_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies a bounded shape cue that can improve a linear margin when individual coordinates have coordinated movement.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "unusual_profile_shape_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assessor score from 0.0 to 1.0 for unusual multi-column profile geometry relative to the training-fold ranges, considering simultaneous extremes and uneven spacing.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_profile_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a smooth expert-style severity measure that complements radial distance and pair ratios.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
